description: NUTBUSTER cross-platform implementation and verification ledger. Status describes code coverage, NOT real-device certification.

features.name: Authored campaign stages, replay and progression
features.gap: Native scripted stage mechanics and final progression/save parity remain incomplete.

features.name: Match-three swaps, board goals and gravity
features.gap: Later-stage blockers, specials, transport, combo effects and per-turn differential replay remain incomplete. 2026-10-31 review: mobile deadlock repair now moves elemental identity with type/hold/special, tested on a no-match held-nut repair; native SDL3 preview does not yet implement mobile elemental payloads or the same deadlock repair, so no C++ gameplay equivalence or status upgrade is claimed.

features.name: Ice, locks, chests, jam and tile overlays
features.gap: Only a subset of original damage and movement/overlay effects runs natively.

features.name: Boosters, held nut effects, combo specials
features.gap: Native SDL3 confirmed 15/30-gem Butter/Jam hold shop, mobile-parity 25-gem starting wallet and +10 gem board-win reward, finite stock purchase/use, V4 wallet/inventory persistence, V1/V2/V3 migration, approved Peanut/hourglass sprites and headless purchase UI regression source implemented; exact-commit Windows/Linux CI and packaged visual acceptance pending. Full native Shop, accessibility labels, in-progress board save, mobile save import, other boosters and special-combo parity remain incomplete. 2026-10-31 review: mobile Butter one-drop expiry and held elemental identity through deadlock repair now have focused tests; native C++ held-nut gravity/scoring fixtures do not cover the unported elemental/repair path. Native remains preview-partial.

features.name: Elemental powers, trial stages and rewards
features.gap: Port trial unlock flow, power resolution and elemental rewards.

features.name: Nutvale mining, seeded ore and rewards
features.gap: Native mining input exists but mobile progression/save and wider minigame parity are incomplete.

features.name: Mining equipment and 40-tier approved artwork
features.gap: Full UI, earned-currency integration and mobile save migration remain incomplete.

features.name: Homestead and house/renovation systems
features.gap: Native Homestead scenes, controls, inventory and progression are absent.

features.name: Fishing, rods, catches and Wharf
features.gap: Native fishing, Wharf and upgrades are absent.

features.name: Shop bundles, random payouts and currency economy
features.gap: Native shops, paid-style free checkout, randomness and booster economy are absent.

features.name: Daily rewards, promo codes and persistence
features.gap: Native preview saves progress and mine only; no mobile save import, promo or full account reset.

features.name: Sound, music and announcer playback
features.gap: 2026-10-30 review: The 93 owner-recorded Nutvale Diva MP3s, original voice, Auditor, captions, and three-way announcer selector ship in the shared Android/Fire OS WebView source. Native SDL3 Windows/Linux previews still have no audio engine or voice selector; do not claim desktop announcer parity.

features.name: Signed updater, platform-safe release packaging
features.gap: Android signed updater exists; native desktop updater, installers and parity release gate are pending.

features.name: Companions, avatar art and customization
features.gap: Native companion models, avatar selection, wardrobe and home display are absent.

features.name: Voluntary parody ads and earned rewards
features.gap: Native ad-style reward scene and its free payout logic are absent.

features.name: Game feedback effects and HUD transitions
features.gap: Native direct-rendered effects and timed HUD feedback have not been ported.

features.name: User-invoked invites, share and platform integrations
features.gap: Native desktop sharing and optional invitations are not implemented.

features.name: Nutdex, authored icon identity and guides
features.gap: Native Nutdex encyclopedia, entries and icon-to-mechanic navigation are absent.

features.name: Nutvale authored economy art and item display
features.gap: Native economy item illustrations and fully matching catalog presentation are incomplete.

targetImpact.linux: Independent native SDL3 Menu scene has no Rupee Rush image or promotion to remove; native gameplay parity remains preview-partial.

It changes neither nut identity/physics, vertical gravity segments, match rules, saved progress, native SDL3 code nor signing.
